calculation_handling.description: Designates the areas of the Sixplex Overlay Map (Diagrams 1 and 2 of By-law 654-2025) that are subject to the Section 600.60 regulations. It sets no value itself.
calculation_handling.gaps: The Sixplex Overlay Map geometry is not held, so membership of a lot in the overlay area cannot be tested.

600.60.10(1).explanation: The sixplex rules in Section 600.60 only apply to land inside the heavy lines of the Sixplex Overlay Map (Diagrams 1 and 2 of By-law 654-2025). A property outside those lines is not covered.
